title: Tests with anti-patterns
description: Every test the find-test-anti-patterns skill found showing an anti-pattern, one entry each, so later steps work from this list instead of searching the code again. The assessment file's anti_patterns section summarises it. Kept as testing/anti-pattern-tests.yaml, next to the assessment file.

modules.description: In a repo with more than one module, the modules searched so far, each as its folder from the repo root. Absent when the repo has one module.

tests.description: Sorted by path (byte order), then by line as a number.

at.description: path:line, the path from the repo root and the line with the test's name (a scenario's Scenario: line, or an examples row).

name.description: <Class>.<method>, or for a Cucumber scenario <feature file>: <scenario title>, with the row's line for an examples row.

reaches.description: For reaches-shared-system: each host the test reaches, and how.

host.description: The host name or IP address, without scheme, port or path.

through.description: Where the host is named: in the test's code, in a properties or YAML file it loads, in a Spring XML context it loads (or a file that context loads), or only in the airgap agent's reports.

where.description: path:line of the line naming the host.

copy_of.description: For copy-pasted: path:line of one test it was copied from or to.
